content_fields.title: Secure symmetric-key authentication
content_fields.description: Load the symmetric signing key from a secret store with a minimum length, and fail startup if it is absent.
content_fields.finding: The symmetric HS256 signing key is taken from Settings.JWT_SECRET_KEY, which falls back to a six-digit random value.
criteria: The process refuses to start without an externally supplied key.
Keys shorter than 32 bytes are rejected.
No key material is generated inside the application.
